positions.title: Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
•	Design and test software for the Ultrasound R&D team
•	Created a developer tool for managing the way processes communicate with each other by comparing data and statistics collected across each process
•	Use agile development practices which include daily scrum meetings, planning for each sprint, and completing assigned tasks

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
•	Instruct and supervise children through projects and activities using Lego
•	Teach engineering concepts to children
•	Design and implement curriculum that focuses on problem-solving

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
•	Provide supplemental instruction to students in mathematics, physics, and chemistry
•	Assess the needs of students and develop tutoring strategies that cater to their learning style
•	Provide study skills and test taking strategies

positions.title: Paper Mill Sparehand
positions.description:

•	Operated paper machine to produce paper to customer specifications
